historical_references.reference: The term 'Andalusi' originated from the Arabic name for the Iberian Peninsula, Al-Andalus, which was ruled by the Muslim Umayyad dynasty between 750 and 1031 AD.
historical_references.context: Muslim Umayyad rule in Iberian Peninsula

historical_references.reference: The term 'Andalusi' was also used to refer to the culture, arts and sciences that flourished in Al-Andalus during the Middle Ages. The period of Andalusi civilization lasted from the early 8th century to the mid-15th century, when the Christian Reconquista brought an end to Muslim rule in the Iberian Peninsula.
historical_references.context: Andalusi civilization and Muslim rule in Iberian Peninsula
